assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The member presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management
Prior approval is required by SilverBridge Advantage for this diagnostic procedure to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility
